title: Midnight Stealth: Don't Wake Mom!
description: A first-person stealth sim where every sound counts. Five midnight missions: sneak downstairs for instant ramen, win a secret 3 AM ranked match, intercept a food delivery before the doorbell, smuggle a friend in and out, or steal your confiscated phone from Mom's nightstand. Watch the decibel meter, read the risk on every move, and stay undetected.
